answer: Anchor each identity to one community garden plot held under a single tenancy: the plot, its trellis and willow boundary, is registered to one agent, who must log seasonal work, attend scheduled workdays, and have neighbouring plot holders countersign the plot's condition each month. A plot cannot wander between identities mid-season, and a transfer voids its accumulated weight. A sybil farm therefore needs one real plot, one regular physical presence, and months of visible cultivation per fake, while copied photos or absent plots are exposed by neighbours who walk the same rows.
